_what: The values every account reads as its own until the person changes them, published by the default publisher with the deploy. Each payload of kind `shipped-default` is one record's default: `record` is the label of the person's own record it is read under, `value` the fields it ships. A reader lays it under the person's record (trillion-rust src/records/shipped_defaults.rs) and never writes it into the person's store: a field the person keeps wins; `merge` names the fields kept as lists by id (`by_id`: a person's entry with the same id replaces the shipped one) and the fields kept as lists of ids that a person switches off (`switched`: each shipped id is on unless the person's own `off_in` map holds it with on false). A changed value here reaches every account that never touched it on the next deploy, with no row written.
